1.  This application has been filed under Section 389 Cr.P.C. read with Section 482 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the Appellant Rakesh Kumar Sood S/o Late Sh. Jagdish Chander Sood, seeking suspension of sentence on the ground of illness of his mother.

Appellant was convicted by the Trial Court by judgment dated 26.09.2020, in case FIR No.1569/2015 dated 15.12.2015 registered at PS:
Govindpuri, for offences under Sections 376(2)(i) IPC and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and has been sentenced vide order on sentence dated 23.10.2020 to RI for 20 years and a fine of Rs.50,000/- and a default sentence of RI for one year.

Considering the fact that mother of the Appellant, who is over 85 years of age, is suffering from various ailments including those of spine and lungs and her health condition is deteriorating, as indicated from the medical documents placed on record, which have been verified to be genuine by the State, this Court is inclined to grant interim suspension of sentence to the Appellant for a period of eight weeks from the date of his release,subject to his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety of like amount, to the satisfaction of learned Trial Court and further subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Appellant will not leave the country without prior permission of this Court;
(ii) He shall not indulge in any criminal activity or communicate with or come in contact with the Victim or any other person associated with the present case;
(iii) He shall provide his permanent residential address to the concerned IO and shall intimate the IO as well as this Court by filing an affidavit regarding any change in the residential address;
